name: AGC Inc.
summary: AGC Inc. manufactures and sells architectural glass, electronics, chemicals, automotive, and ceramics worldwide. The company offers architectural glass products, including insulated, laminated, wired, toughened, solar control, sound insulation, decorative, float and patterned, and industrial glass, as well as structural glazing systems and industrial glass; automotive glass for displays, sensors and connected drive, windows, and trains; and glass substrates used for thin-film-transistor liquid crystal displays and OLEDs.
